rationale: The compiled artifacts faithfully implement the reviewed design. The two seed_edits insert the roadmap-review announcements into #engineering (authored by Hubert, an existing member) and #core-infra (authored by Lukas, an existing member), preserving the membership-not-authorship logic and leaving all other base-seed records unchanged. The selector (users→channel_members→channels→messages, filtering real_name contains 'Robert' and message_text contains both 'roadmap review' and 'Friday') mechanically resolves to exactly the intended two matches (U03ROBERT23, U_ROBERT) — verified against the full seed, no other user has 'Robert' in real_name, and no other message in the seed contains both 'roadmap review' and 'Friday', so no accidental extra matches arise. Morgan Stanley (U05MORGAN23) correctly falls out as a near-miss (right channel/message, wrong name) rather than a match, matching the design's negative intent, and appears in computed_focal_negatives/near_misses as expected. The offtopic-channel negatives (#general, #product-growth) are pre-existing background records left untouched, correctly not entering the match set since they lack the qualifying announcement. Bindings, candidate_role_sets, written/change attributes (messages.message_text), and the identifying-paths/referent-set separation in the card all align with the locked design and the meta-model's separation of entity/edge sequences from predicates. The access plan uses only documented, unrestricted API calls (conversations.list/history/members, users.info, and implicitly conversations.open + chat.postMessage for the DM), and the actor is seeded as a member of both qualifying channels (#engineering, #core-infra), enabling realistic discovery. No mechanical errors were reported and none were found on independent re-derivation of the match set. This remains a strong underspecified case: short natural prompt, a genuine unresolved referent forced by two structurally identical but distinct real users, a consequential state-changing action, and well-targeted non-hinting negatives.
